name: Woven, weft-faced: the image in the weave

roughness.note: No gloss of a tapestry was read: wool is near matte, the silk highlights carried by the image.

roughnessAcross.source: the image carries what grain the face shows

haziness.note: One specular lobe until a goniometric measurement shows a second.

textureDepth.note: A first value for the ribs the weft makes over the warp (a Morris & Co. tapestry, about seven warps a centimetre).

relief.source: the image carries the weave's hatching
relief.derivation: no relief is drawn over the work's own image
